=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text data "21 -4 7 7 0 88 -15 3 42 9 1 -4 60"
global vals long 16
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note parse reads the decimal numbers in s (separated by spaces, an optional - sign) into vals and
note returns how many; one pass over s, so the loop is bounded by len s
fn parse s view uchar * to ulong
n = ulong 0
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
for i ulong len s
c = get s i
if eq c 45
sg = long -1
else
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 long sub c 48
dig = true
else
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
end
end
end
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
ret n
end
note show writes vals[0..n-1] separated by spaces, then a newline
fn show n ulong to void
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emiti get vals i
end
emit nl
end
note cssort runs forward and backward passes over vals[b..e]; after a forward pass everything past the
note last swap is in place, so e moves to it, and b likewise after a backward pass; each round moves
note e down or b up by at least one, so n rounds (at most 16) suffice
fn cssort n ulong to void
b = ulong 0
e = sub n 1
while lt b e bound 16
ls = b
i = b
while lt i e bound 16
if gt get vals i get vals add i 1
t = get vals i
put vals i get vals add i 1
put vals add i 1 t
ls = i
end
i = add i 1
end
e = ls
fs = e
i = e
while gt i b bound 16
if gt get vals sub i 1 get vals i
t = get vals i
put vals i get vals sub i 1
put vals sub i 1 t
fs = i
end
i = sub i 1
end
b = fs
end
end
fn main to int
n = parse data
show n
cssort n
show n
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
21 -4 7 7 0 88 -15 3 42 9 1 -4 60
-15 -4 -4 0 1 3 7 7 9 21 42 60 88
</pre>
